windows.text: Your small intestine runs on glutamine, but the colonocytes lining your large intestine rely on short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) like butyrate. You get them when your gut bacteria ferment raw resistant starch, or from your home-brewed SIBO yogurt. They feed the colonocytes.
